display_long_description:
RaceFault VR Car Racing — arcade drift racing built for Meta Quest

Grip the wheel, hit the nitro, and slide through 10 high-speed tracks in a VR racing game made for pure arcade fun. No simulator learning curve — just fast cars, tight drift lines, and lap times worth chasing.

RACE 10 HIGH-SPEED TRACKS
Tear through neon city highways, volcanic lava cliffs, cyberpunk skylines, and anti-gravity loops. Every circuit has its own racing line, shortcuts, and cornering rhythm to learn.

DRIFT, BOOST, REPEAT
Chain drifts through hairpins to build nitro. Launch out of corners with turbo bursts. Clean cornering means faster laps — and faster laps mean bigger rewards.

UNLOCK AND UPGRADE 6 CARS
Six cars, each with its own speed, grip, and handling feel. Spend earned coins on performance upgrades, then make it yours with skins, nitro kits, and horns.

AI COMPANION RACERS
Your AI rivals react to perfect drifts, near misses, and win streaks — so every race feels alive instead of scripted.

CLIMB THE GLOBAL LEADERBOARDS
Post your lap times, compare against racers worldwide, and come back to shave off another tenth of a second.

BUILT FOR COMFORTABLE VR
Designed for smooth VR racing in short sessions or long runs. Comfort rating: Moderate.

Compatible with Meta Quest 2, Quest 3, Quest 3S, and Quest Pro.

Start your engine and take the first corner.
